# Barney Pullen

## Overview

- **Age:** Twenty years old
- **Gender:** Male
- **Origin:** Brierley  <sub>[v1 c11 P18](../source/v01-c11.md#nw-v01-c11-p0018)</sub>

## Appearance

Barney is a large, overweight, emotionless twenty-year-old youth with a round, expressionless face. He has an unrefined conversational manner and a habit of smirking.

## Personality

Barney is exceptionally quiet, rarely speaking or laughing. He possesses an agonizing inability to hold a conversation, often smirking or laughing softly when addressed because he cannot devise an answer until after the opportunity has passed. Despite his awkwardness, he takes immense pride in accompanying young women he admires. He enjoys rowing people out on the Lake of Glassy Waters.

## Traits

- Taciturn
- Socially awkward
- Proud
- Quiet

## Abilities

- Rowing
- Driving a horse buggy  <sub>[v1 c14 P65](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0065)</sub>

## History

During the Sunday-school picnic at Brierley, Barney brought groups of attendees out rowing six at a time on the Lake of Glassy Waters. When Odette Pullen nearly fell into the water reaching for lilies, Gorham Pullen caught her by her sash, which Barney later reflected would have made a romantic adventure had it happened to someone else. Later in the summer, Barney was recruited by Thirza Abernethy to harness the sorrel horse to take Nell Harcourt to the picnic. Later that evening, he drove a double-seated buggy containing Nell, Isolde Pembroke, and Odette Pullen to the Sunday-school picnic event. During the journey, he demanded that Nell sit beside him on the front seat, taking great pride in driving with her at his side despite his inability to converse easily.

_Sources: [v1 c14 P65](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0065)_
